answer: One workable check is a refundable stake tied to a single verified device. An agent that wants to trade must lock, say, 50 units for 30 days and prove it controls one ferrous hardware key, the kind stamped into a phone secure element. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand keys, while a genuine operator pays once. A gale of cheap identities stops being cheap, and a registry can revoke the jade badge shown on verified profiles when the stake is slashed for fraud.
